name: Onna Kyoushi Mesu Dorei
source:
Class gathers for bathing at the sea, but one girl goes missing. Female teacher and another student follow missing girl's steps to the offshore island. There they encounters a fugitive murderer, and a horrible night starts for the two females.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
班级到海边集体沐浴，一名女孩却失踪了。女教师和另一名学生循着失踪女孩的踪迹来到近海小岛。在那里，她们遇见一名逃亡杀人犯，两名女性可怕的一夜就此开始。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
